pitch.heading: Down the coast road to Skeel
pitch.text: You have walked the coast road for a week with a little money and no reason to stop. This morning it comes over the shoulder of a down, and below you is the Gannet Reach: nine miles of shining sand, or of shining sea, depending on the hour, with islands in it, and a town of grey roofs on the near headland, and out on the sands a ship lying on her side.
